source: The game's own rating -> effect functions, evaluated at every rating 0..3000 (StatCurves.csv).
unconfirmed: Combo Speed and Accuracy have no curve of their own in this export.

curves.meaning: Skill Speed: percent faster skill animations
Skill Recovery: percent faster cooldown recovery
Mana Generation: percent more Ultimate mana gained
Instinct: the factor the game reads for Instinct (0-1 scale)
Defense: damage multiplier taken at this DEF (1 = full damage)
Resist chance (percent) where rating = target RES minus attacker ACC, offset by 1500 (row 1500 = equal RES and ACC)
